details: Leaders from the US, China, and Russia held an unprecedented summit, releasing a symbolic "peace declaration" and affirming that nuclear war must be avoided. The declaration also touched on UN reforms and increasing fuel supplies. However, it offered no concrete solutions for the ongoing Ukraine war or the US-Iran conflict, raising concerns among European allies. Separately, middle powers like Canada and Japan are actively forming new trade alliances to reduce their reliance on major global players, responding to uncertainties in US trade policies.
title: Trump, Xi, Putin Issue 'Peace Declaration' Amid New Middle Power Alliances

details: US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen anticipates "solid growth" for the American economy in the coming year, despite acknowledging that inflation remains "too high." She warned of potential spillover effects on the US from an economic slowdown in European economies. The Federal Reserve recently implemented its largest interest rate hike since 2000, increasing the benchmark rate by 50 basis points to counter persistent inflation.
title: US Treasury Predicts Growth, Cautions on European Slowdown and High US Inflation

details: Italy experienced a general strike involving tens of thousands of workers and students, organized by the CGIL trade union, demanding higher wages and increased public service investments. This is part of a broader wave of youth mobilization across Europe, with protests against rising living costs and military spending also planned in Germany, France, Britain, Austria, Belgium, and Spain.
title: Europe Rocked by Widespread Strikes and Youth Protests

details: The US dollar has emerged as the only major asset to see gains in November 2026, while Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced significant drops of approximately 25% and 28% respectively, with the total crypto market cap falling to $2.1-$2.2 trillion. This downturn is attributed to expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening and reduced stablecoin liquidity. Concurrently, Asia's stock markets have dived amid fears of an "AI bubble" after a major AI company's IPO failed to reassure investors, exacerbating a broader tech sell-off.
title: Crypto Market Downturn Amidst Fed Tightening and AI Bubble Fears

details: Mexico is expected to finalize a new trade agreement with the European Union by the end of the year. This move is driven by increasing uncertainty surrounding access to the US market, influenced by President Donald Trump's repeated tariff threats. Both the EU and Mexico, for whom the US is a major trading partner, are seeking to diversify their trade relationships in response to these protectionist pressures.
title: EU and Mexico Strengthen Trade Ties Amidst US Uncertainty

details: The ongoing US-Iran conflict persists in influencing global financial markets through its effects on energy prices, shipping routes, economic sanctions, and investor confidence. The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical chokepoint, posing an immediate threat to commercial shipping. The US maritime agency warned that the blockade of Iranian ports was increasing Gulf premiums. While major equity markets have shown some recovery since the conflict's outset and crude oil prices have eased from their peaks, volatility continues, and fuel prices remain above pre-conflict levels.
title: Ongoing US-Iran Conflict Continues to Impact Global Energy Markets
